description: Quantick repository guardrails shared with Claude Code.

hooks.command: sh -lc 'root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 0; exec sh "$root/.claude/hooks/guardrails.sh" worktree-guard'
hooks.commandWindows: $hookRepoRoot = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 0 }; $hookGitRoot = Split-Path -Parent (Split-Path -Parent (Get-Command git.exe).Source); $hookShell = Join-Path -Path $hookGitRoot -ChildPath 'bin\sh.exe'; [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | & $hookShell --login (Join-Path -Path $hookRepoRoot -ChildPath '.claude/hooks/guardrails.sh') worktree-guard; exit $LASTEXITCODE
